description: Election Commission - P. H. W. S. Karunarathne was Selected as the member of the Kundasale Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kundasale Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new member by a recognized political party, which falls under electoral processes and related administrative matters. This fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with candidate nominations and declarations for local authority positions.
